Name: Personal Watering Can
Author: Xvordan
Description: Water your crops barehanded using a rechargeable hydration meter. Drink beverages to recharge; press Z (empty-handed) to toggle personal-watering mode on or off (default on), then hold the tool button to charge and release to fire.
